Hi Liam / Sarah — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick written recap + clear next steps so we all have the same picture.

Summary of pain & goals
- Audit logs: Northwind needs 2+ years of immutable audit log retention for transaction metadata and user activity; current vendor exports are too coarse.
- SOC 2 scope: You want Redwood to cover storage, API, and control-plane telemetry for a scoped SOC 2 (Type II) report; key ask is list of evidence artifacts.
- DPA / data residency: Procurement will want a DPA with explicit retention and subprocessor clauses.
- Pen test: You run an annual pen test window and require an outline of Redwood's scope and preferred dates.

What we committed to (owners + rough timeline)
1) Evidence index: Redwood to send a spreadsheet with mapped SOC 2 artifacts (access logs, change control, deployment manifests) — owner: Marissa. ETA: 2 business days.
2) Audit-log retention options: Short doc outlining retention tiers (90d / 1yr / 2yr), storage S3 lifecycle, and export APIs — owner: Karthik. ETA: 3 business days.
3) DPA redline: Draft DPA with retention and audit rights language — owner: Irene (legal + procurement loop). ETA: EOW (May 14).
4) Pen-test scope & scheduling: Short scope doc + preferred windows — owner: Security Ops (we'll attach summary). ETA: 5 business days.

Requested from Northwind
- A single point of contact for procurement and security (you mentioned Sarah for security, and procurement@northwind-pay.com for legal).
- Any existing evidence templates or checklists you prefer we map into (if you have a proprietary index).

Attachments (for reference)
- redwood-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx (stub)
- pen-test-scope-summary.pdf (stub)
- dpa-redline-northwind-v1.docx (we will send the redline separately)

Proposed next touchpoints
- Quick sync Wednesday 11am PT to review evidence index (if that still works for your team).
- Follow-up with DPA redline by EOW.

If anything above is off, please flag edits inline and I will update. Thanks again — looking forward to getting this moving so we can keep you in the next quarter's ramp.

Best,

Can Sarah be your security contact to coordinate the pen test scope and evidence acceptance? Sarah, looping you in — are the dates above feasible?
